build.beforeDevCommand: bun run bundle:plugins && bun run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run bundle:plugins && bun run build

bundle.shortDescription: Fork of OpenUsage — tray app to track AI coding subscriptions (credit: Robin Ebers / robinebers/openusage).
bundle.longDescription: CrossUsage is a community fork of OpenUsage (https://github.com/robinebers/openusage), the open-source AI subscription usage tracker created by Robin Ebers (https://github.com/robinebers, https://itsbyrob.in/x). This repository (https://github.com/barramee27/crossusage) focuses on Linux and Windows native builds; upstream remains the macOS-first home of OpenUsage. Please credit Robin Ebers and the OpenUsage project when discussing or redistributing derivative work.
bundle.copyright: CrossUsage fork contributors; original OpenUsage © Robin Ebers and contributors
